claims.text: On American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 22 November 2025, at 3:56:16 to 3:58:57, Peter Levenda said he spent a full day in a conference room in Austin, arranged by Tom DeLonge, with Chris Mellon, Harold Puthoff and Jacques Vallee. He said that when the group asked about a specific matter concerning Skinwalker Ranch, the equipment used there and the data collected, all three fell silent, and that Puthoff then said 'we need a skiff for this one' and would not say why. Levenda gives the account in the first person as a participant and says he took contemporaneous notes.
